# Public example data

Three logs from the Deep4ge training split.
Source: https://github.com/SigmaJahan/deep4ge/tree/1d895afac1985876f289fbcdc2ee56c62f612071

Dataset license: CC BY 4.0. See https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Only observed input columns are included in the CSV exports. Published categories
and source hashes remain in index.json for explicitly labelled demonstrations.
No validation or final-test examples are exported.
